comments.author: @TwoFatesOneBorder
comments.text: The 'capital for the 1780s' framing says it all — a city built for a different era now sinking, shaking and running dry. Moving a 10-million-person capital 900 miles to the Makran coast, where nothing has been built yet, feels less like a plan and more like an admission. The 'why it probably won't happen' chapter was the honest ending this needed.
